value.rationale: The published model makes predator loss under chaotic prey an interpretive focus, but almost-sure transverse decay is not interchangeable with mean-square decay. The exact open region with opposing signs, including a simple rational witness and all-n fourth moments, quantifies a motivated distinction between typical and rare transient amplification. The two-parameter moment transfer enables further quantitative response analysis; this is not a routine mere renaming of the logistic conjugacy.
